title: Z9.F original inverse — Prescribed rational target has actual absolute HasSum
milestone_description: For each even n>=2 and b:Fin5->Rat, the actual inverse rational quartic multiplier produces a HasSum of the actual weightedR at positive integers with value prescribedL(b), and its absolute norms are Summable. The input b contains the rational constant and zeta3,5,7,9 coefficients. This is the original genuine HasSum, not a totalized tsum identity. Integer inverse coefficients, height bounds and irrationality remain unproved here.
